She sent me for a scan a few years back just to be on the safe side, what dr does that these days eh?! I will always wait to see her if I can’t get hold of her one day or week, unless of course I genuinely believe I am about to die lol, because she’s the only dr I actually trust & I will never see anyone else! So if ever you need to see a Dr ask for Dr. McAvoy!!! She also sometimes has pre bookable appointments to, but she’s only there two days a week, the rest of the week she works at another surgery in Truro, Monday & Wednesday she is up at Lander I believe but don’t quote me on those days.
